title: Operations KPI Dashboard (Power BI)
summary: Power BI dashboards that tracked operational KPIs and improved decision visibility across engineering and operations.
problem: Operational performance data existed across multiple systems, which made it hard for stakeholders to quickly understand KPI health, diagnose issues, and prioritize workflow improvements.
approach: Defined KPI requirements with stakeholders, wrote SQL queries (Snowflake + Redzone) to generate reliable views, and built Power BI dashboards designed for repeatable operational reviews.
outcome: Improved visibility into operational KPIs and enabled faster, more consistent data-driven discussions across teams.
